text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At a press conference, Daiichi Ruby 
announces her entry into the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen. She then issues a 
declaration of war to the still-slumbering 
K.S.Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if hearing that voice, K.S. Miracle 
wished to run once more—and opened her 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle stands up once more, reaching 
out toward a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stronger, faster—toward such a future. To 
make a fresh start, she decided to run in 
the Swan Stakes.
